name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All 9 trials scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success, so there is no gradient to follow and no noise estimate beyond "all zero". The trials covered recipe changes (1 or 2 epochs, gamma 0.95 to 0.995), per-layer heads, a dense action head, a layout-free MLP and action-query attention. Failing every way suggests either that exact builds are out of reach at this budget, or that the world differs from its description in a way none of these designs exploited. The MLP's failure argues against a simple action-layout mismatch alone. The baseline's receptive field is shallow (two 3x3 convs) and its updates are few and large. For this last round I'm placing three different bets: (1) the baseline with many small, sharp, short-horizon updates; (2) a deeper fully convolutional ResNet whose head is a learned conv over each footprint window; (3) a small transformer that sees the whole grid, for ordering that depends on distant cells.
